changes.title: Attack feel
items: Attacks read better: creatures crouch as they wind up and stretch out as they lunge, a hit squashes its target and it springs back, a hard knock bowls it over once, and every blow lands with a crisp pixel star, a puff of dust and a spray of bits in that animal's own colours (or party confetti)

changes.title: Owl evolution
items: The owl evolves: a downy owlet with huge eyes, a smooth young with short ear tufts, an adult with a dark-rimmed face, long tufts, a barred chest and patterned wings, and the legend: wings half spread like a cloak edged in moonlight, tufts swept back like horns and a ring of glowing eyes round its face

changes.title: Hud calm
items: The HUD is calmer at night: one warm lantern-amber accent instead of yellow, magenta and cyan, smaller wave numbers over the runestones, a smaller and softer next-stone ring in the area's colour, and the wave · areas line only in debug
